rule: Each figure has one long diagonal-ish arrow starting at a corner (TL, TR, BR, BL, TL going clockwise) plus a few straight lines. Best guess: lines number at most 2 (1,2,1,?,2), so the only figure with three lines is the odd one. Other candidate rules (axis-aligned lines in 1,3,5 vs diagonal lines in 2,4) split 3/2 and so do not isolate one figure.
options_check: 1: one horizontal line touching arrow, fits. 2: two diagonal lines crossing arrow, fits count rule. 3: one vertical line at corner, fits. 4: three diagonal lines crossing arrow, breaks count rule. 5: two vertical lines crossing arrow, fits.
